::: {.manual-prereq title="Confirm Access To CDS"}

Before querying ERA5-Land data, confirm that the CDS client, credentials, and
project output location are available.

```{python}
#| eval: false
from pathlib import Path

assert Path("README.md").exists(), "Expected to run this page from the project root."
assert Path.home().joinpath(".cdsapirc").exists(), "Expected CDS credentials in ~/.cdsapirc."
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Declare The ERA5-Land Request"}

The source script defines a CDS request for hourly ERA5-Land variables over
Kenya, then loops over monthly time windows because the CDS restricts large
requests.

```{python}
#| eval: false
# Pseudocode based on 01_Query_ERA5_CDSAPI_Kenya_v1.py
dataset = "reanalysis-era5-land"
variables = [
    "2m_temperature",
    "2m_dewpoint_temperature",
    "skin_temperature",
]
area = {
    "north": "...",
    "west": "...",
    "south": "...",
    "east": "...",
}
time_range = {
    "years": range(2000, 2024),
    "months": ["01", "02", "...", "12"],
    "hours": ["00:00", "01:00", "...", "23:00"],
}
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Download Monthly NetCDF Files"}

The source script retrieves one month at a time and writes each result to a raw
data directory.

```{python}
#| eval: false
from pathlib import Path

raw_dir = Path("data/raw/era5land")
raw_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# Pseudocode based on 01_Query_ERA5_CDSAPI_Kenya_v1.py
for year in time_range["years"]:
    for month in time_range["months"]:
        target = raw_dir / f"era5land_kenya_{year}_{month}.nc"
```
